label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering with bread refreshments and a private community presentation in the great hall at eighteen sharp. The innkeeper is arranging the mayor's escort and preventing early arrival; neighbour delivered thirty-two loaves and saw baker adding more. Freight and builder appear to assist with supplies or arrangements, while secretary knowingly helps scheduling. The private presentation may celebrate the mayor's forty years of service, but that purpose remains an inference, not confirmed knowledge.
